scope_gate.smaller: One explicit potential and the complete H source grammar, not arbitrary feature synthesis or a universal coverage search.
scope_gate.mechanism: The old RG03 plateau erases which SET-cardinality layers are replaced. Perfect-block recurrences permit exact layer counts; A locality follows from one true SET loss/creation per primitive rotation.
scope_gate.success: Prove A locality and the parametric H3q drop, then prove the stated all-source B law or give an admissible complete source family refuting that exact candidate. A refutation does not refute other potentials or Universal CD.
scope_gate.novelty_limit: Fixed-cardinality birth retirement has prior proofs. An exact-layer sharpening or potential encoding is not advertised as a strict enlargement of the current UF paid class.
scope_gate.upward_effect: Decide whether this new candidate can supply the missing B-phase conservation interface. Preserve any valid scoped layer theorem and isolate its literal complement.

verification_plan.implementations: New mutable parent-pointer primitive tracer checked operation-by-operation against the frozen independent tuple splay core. All real primitive IDs and before/after subtree SET changes are retained.
verification_plan.independence: Two structurally different implementations; same-agent orchestration, not independent-agent, peer or formal proof-assistant certification.
verification_plan.new_replay_budget: At most180 CPU seconds and200000 real rotations. No unrelated search, solver or prior campaign budget reset.
verification_plan.symbolic_requirement: Finite replays validate implementation and witnesses only. Quantified q/p claims require symbolic full-source recurrence proofs.

preservation: Only new files under this directory and the authorized Notion research destination may be written. Prior code, source words, proofs, seals, owners, configuration and Git remain untouched. Use Python -B and prevent inherited imports from writing caches.
